Jordan — thanks for the notice and for sending the docs. A few quick clarifications from our side before we update the vendor profile and change routing: 

1) Can you confirm whether the new account should be used for all invoices (existing and future) or only for invoices dated on/after 2026-10-01?
2) Do you have a vendor-specific remittance reference (e.g., AP contact + remittance email) that should be updated in our system?
3) Please confirm the tax classification remains unchanged — we have your W-9 but want to ensure no EIN/name changes.

Marcus — looping you in for approval of the account change and to confirm whether we need any extra verification (bank letter is helpful; our policy sometimes requires a voided check or bank confirmation). Karthik — FYI for vendor portal steps and PO routing adjustments if we proceed.

If everything is in order, we typically make the switch on the first business day after the effective date you provide and will post a vendor-note in the portal.

Best,
Stephanie Nguyen

Hi Stephanie — thanks for the quick reply. Answers below and attaching a PDF copy of the same bank letter that includes an ACH confirmation page.

1) Please route all invoices dated 2026-10-01 and after to the new account. For invoices issued prior to that date, please leave them on the legacy account (we’ll clear any outstanding items there).
2) Updated remittance contact: payables@aldersystems.com (same inbox) — please change the vendor portal remit-to bank details only, not the remittance email.
3) No changes to EIN or legal name — W-9 remains valid.

Attached: bank_change_letter_aldersystems.pdf (includes ACH confirmation)

We can also provide a notarized bank letter if required by your policy; happy to do that quickly. Let me know when you’ve completed the portal update and whether any outstanding POs will be impacted.

Best,
Jordan
